senses.gloss: ch. same, to be lean, weak; v. כָּחִישׁ.—
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 95a:15">Snh. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ חיליה</he> his strength failed him.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 104b:12">B. Mets. 104ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>תִּכְחוֹשׁ ארעא ולא לִיכְּחוּשׁ מרה</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="K00471"><he>כחשא</he></cite>) let the land deteriorate (exhausted by strong seeds) rather than that its owner become reduced (by reduced income); a. e.

<cite ref="Niddah 47b:48">Nidd. 47ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Yevamot 97a:7">Yeb. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>אַכְחֲשׁוּהוּ</he> reduce him (by scanty food); <cite ref="Bava Batra 155b:3">B. Bath. 155ᵇ</cite> <he>אכחשיה</he> Ms. M. (corr. acc., ed. <he>ליכחוש</he>, v. infra).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 34a:11">B. Kam. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>את מַכְחֲשָׁהּ ואנא וכ׳</he> thou didst ruin her (by neglect), and I should pay for it?
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 48">Gen. R. s. 48</cite>, beg. <he>אַכְחֲשָׁהּ קדמה</he> he contradicted her (his wife) in her (the servant’s) presence.

senses.gloss: to reduce one’s self, to be reduced. B. Bath. l. c. לִיכְּחוּשׁ let him reduce himself. B. Mets. l. c., v. supra.

units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 74a:10">B. Kam. 74ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְכַּחֲשֵׁי</he> are contradicted, contrad. to <he>מיתזמי</he>, v. <cite ref="G00527"><he>זְמַם</he> I</cite>.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 81b:15">Snh. 81ᵇ</cite> <he>אִתְכְּחוּשׁ בבדיקות</he> they contradicted each other in cross-examinations, v. <cite ref="B00146"><he>בְּדִיקָה</he></cite>.
